 Meesaya Murukku 2 to I'm Game to Anakapalli: Watch these latest Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu and Kannada OTT releases on Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video and more
 SECTIONS Meesaya Murukku 2 to I'm Game to Anakapalli: Watch these latest Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu and Kannada OTT releases on Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video and more By ET Entertainment Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 04, 2026, 01:37:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis This week offers a vibrant lineup of South Indian films and shows on OTT platforms, perfect for all viewing preferences. The list includes Dulquer Salmaan's I'm Game and Tamil musical Meesaya Murukku 2 on November 6. Additionally, the Telugu crime drama Anakapalli has made its way to digital streaming, with romantic dramas and a star-studded cooking show. Read on!
 Latest South OTT releases of the week (Credit: Instagram) If you are looking for something new to watch this week, several South Indian movies and shows are arriving on OTT platforms. From Dulquer Salmaan's fantasy action thriller to a Tamil musical comedy-drama and a Telugu crime thriller, there is something for viewers across languages. Here's a look at the latest Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu and Kannada releases, along with their streaming platforms and premiere dates.
 I'm Game - JioHotstar 
 Dulquer Salmaan's fantasy action thriller I'm Game is finally making its digital debut. Directed by Nahas Hidhayath, the film will start streaming on JioHotstar on Friday, November 6. It had a disappointing run at the box office following its theatrical release in September. Viewers can now watch the movie in five languages: Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada.
 You Might Also Like: New OTT releases to watch this week: 9 new movies and shows on Netflix, JioHotstar, Prime Video, ZEE5 and more
 Meesaya Murukku 2 - SonyLIV 
 The Tamil musical comedy-drama Meesaya Murukku 2 will premiere on SonyLIV on Friday, November 6, 2026, coinciding with the Diwali festivities. Directed by and starring Hiphop Tamizha Adhi, alongside Ketika Sharma, the film follows a passionate Gaana singer who dreams of making it big on the global stage. After its successful theatrical run, the movie is now set to reach a wider audience through its digital release. It will be available in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada and Hindi.
 Nooru Kodi Vaanavil - Zee 5 
Written and directed by Sasi, Nooru Kodi Vaanavil is a Tamil romantic drama featuring Harish Kalyan and Siddhi Idnani in the lead roles. The story revolves around a young couple whose relationship faces challenges due to family expectations and misunderstandings. After remaining unreleased for several years, the film is finally making its digital debut, giving audiences an opportunity to watch it online.
 You Might Also Like: Ramayana full cast revealed: Ranbir Kapoor as Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Arun Govil as Dasharath. Who plays whom in Nitesh Tiwari's epic?
 Anakapalli - Sun NXT 
Directed by Khagesh Tammineni, Anakapalli is a Telugu crime action drama starring Vikram Sahidev and Sandhya Vasishta, with Tarak Ponnappa playing an important role. Following its theatrical run, the film made its digital debut on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Viewers can now stream it in Telugu on Sun NXT and Amazon Prime Video.
 Chef Mantra Project K- Aha 
Hosted by Suma Kanakala, the sixth season of the celebrity cooking show Chef Mantra Project K brings together television and internet personalities for a series of kitchen challenges. The participants include Sudigali Sudheer, Emmanuel, Vishnupriya, Arjun Ambati and Yadhamma Raju. The semi-final episode will premiere on aha on November 5.
 Balu Geetha - ETV Win 
Directed by Pratap Kollareddy, Balu Geetha is a Telugu romantic comedy-drama starring Sandeep Saroj and Keyuri Shah. The film also features Krishnudu and Rithvik in important roles. Produced by Supriya Yarlagadda under the Annapurna Studios banner, the movie will make its digital debut on ETV Win on November 5, 2026.
Stay tuned for more releases!
